hints: Is a ROSE a part of a flower, or a kind of flower?
Make a bridge sentence: "A rose is a kind of flower."
Now say: "A mango is a kind of ___." Test each choice. Cross out parts, colors and tastes.

solution.methodName: Make a bridge sentence, then test each choice

steps.action: Make a bridge sentence: "A rose is a kind of flower."
steps.why: Flower is the group, or category. A rose is one member of that group, like a sampaguita or an orchid.

steps.action: Use the same bridge: "A mango is a kind of ___."
Test each choice. A mango is a kind of fruit. A seed is a part of a mango, sweet is how it tastes, and yellow is its color when ripe.

trapNotes.seed: A seed is a part inside a mango. The bridge needs the group a mango belongs to, not one of its parts.
trapNotes.sweet: Sweet describes how a ripe mango tastes. A taste is not the category a mango belongs to.
trapNotes.yellow: Yellow is the color of a ripe mango. A color is not the category a mango belongs to.
